delete_only_after: X0-X8 complete or approved explicitly deferred
No unresolved critical/high findings hidden by scoring
All mandatory device checks performed or expressly blocked with evidence retained
User receives concise final code/CI/device-status report in Chat
Every temporary path accounted before delete
method: On review branch, create tree entries {path,mode:'100644',type:'blob',sha:null} for every tracked review-root file; create deletion commit and fast-forward ref after checking expected SHA. Verify review folder absent. Delete review branch through GitHub UI only if connector lacks delete-ref support.
caveat: Deleting a folder in Git does NOT securely erase historical blobs/commits; never commit private user data at any stage.
